sub_questions.question: How many API calls per month on the free (Sandbox) plan?
Can a Professional plan be paid by bank transfer?

claims.claim: Sandbox workspaces are capped at 5,000 API calls per month.
claims.guide_evidence: | Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew) | 1 | 5 | 50 | 50 MB | 5,000 calls/month |

claims.claim: Professional removes the Dify-imposed API rate limit.
Professional subscriptions can be paid by bank transfer.
claims.guide_evidence: paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify and, if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only — it is not available on any plan today.

claims.claim: Bank transfer can be chosen at checkout.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; paying by invoice or bank transfer ... is not available on any plan today.

customer_safety_issues: Tells the customer bank transfer is available for Professional and can be selected at checkout, which is false per the guide.
evaluation.rationale: The Sandbox 5,000 calls/month figure and the Professional no-limit statement are correct. The answer says Professional can be paid by bank transfer at checkout. The guide says bank transfer is not available on any plan today, and that it might later be limited to annual Team plans. This is a billing entitlement error the customer could act on, for example by upgrading expecting that payment option.
